message: 恐女

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Synn-sama, ain't it still a bit early for the flash sale?」

name: Synn
message: 「Today's a special occasion. Halloween just ended, after all. All the leftover pumpkins are being sold off dirt cheap.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've gotta get to the stores early and pick out the good ones!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, if it isn't the President. Good day to you.」

Just as I was about to charge into Shiokumi Shopping District, a fellow pumpkin hunter who had beaten me to the punch appeared. The plastic shopping bags dangling from both her hands were stuffed with several visibly high-quality pumpkins.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Misasagi-senpai. How's the pumpkin situation looking?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Shinagawa Greengrocer really is the best, you know. Even if Capricore has surplus stock, they've already sent it off to their affiliated businesses.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Inamiya's aren't half bad either, mind you, though the neighborhood housewives have been poking and prodding them so much that plenty are bruised.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Thanks for the tip. Looks like Shinagawa-oba-san's place really is the spot to aim for.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Everyone is out hunting for fine pumpkins, you see. Do give it your very best.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. Though...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm actually a little surprised to be having a conversation like this with you, Misasagi-senpai.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And why might that be? Even I, with you and the others--」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, Ayanishiki-chan. I got the okara from the tofu shop!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Ria-senpai, you're here with her too?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thank you for your trouble, Ria. With this, we can whip up some pumpkin and okara dumplings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... ahhh! You're in the middle of Wagashi Club activities!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ding-dong♪ Bullseye~! Oh, and we're gonna make pumpkin daifuku too. Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp... That sounds delicious. I wish Nanaka would take a page out of your book instead of never making sweets herself.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sh-Synn-kun... Bad boy!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now. I suppose it comes from the familiarity of being childhood friends, but it isn't proper to say such things when the person herself isn't around.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Wouldn't you say Nanaka-han has principles of her own?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. You're completely right.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, as a token of your remorse, might I have some of your milk, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure. If these will do, please take as many as you'd like.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Five bottles will be more than enough.」
Y-You're taking five of these?!

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, wha...? You were scolding Synn-kun over Nanaka-chan... so why are you taking his milk, Ayanishiki-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria! Shhh--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to Ria-chan to actually notice.」
Though she hasn't noticed the size of the milk bottles.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... is there something about my milk?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to Synn-sama to be completely clueless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Milk is good for your body, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not the point!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ohoho... I was hoping to use this milk to make some pumpkin milk yokan.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a wagashi like that!? That sounds even more delicious...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are you interested? The Wagashi Club never turns away anyone who wishes to join.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At the next tasting session, Ria and I will be serving what we've made.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「For the time being, though... Mr. President, here is something in return.」
Misasagi-senpai handed me a single, well-shaped pumpkin.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh dear\s02 Synn-kun...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Welp, he went and took it...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Farewell for now, Mr. President. I shall be looking forward to our upcoming tasting session.」
I bowed as I parted ways with Misasagi-senpai, and standing right there at the entrance to the shopping district, I scrutinized the pumpkin I had just received from every angle.

name: Synn
message: 「This is quite a fine specimen. Misasagi-senpai really has a good eye.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is now really the time to be impressed?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen carefully, okay, Synn-kun? Ayanishiki-chan is going to treat you to some homemade pumpkin milk jelly, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!? That makes me so happy!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-So, you see? That means you have to make some sweets with that pumpkin as a return gift, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh... Whaaat!? All that meaning was hidden in just that tiny exchange?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's what's so scary about black tights, man」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What am I supposed to do?」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh, ummm... Good luck♪ ...maybe?」
After standing frozen for a while, I turn on my heel and head toward the library instead of Shinagawa Greengrocer.
I've got to go borrow a baking book...!
